newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU grants free mkt wheat, barley, rye.
newsitem.headline: EU grants free mkt wheat, barley, rye.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday granted licences to export 192,450 tonnes of free market soft wheat at a maximum refund of 6.49 Ecus per tonne, member country officials said.
The EU's cereals management committee in Brussels also granted exports of 153,000 tonnes of open-market barley at a maximum refund of 30.95 Ecus per tonne, they said.
The EU also granted the export of 32,000 tonnes of free market rye at a maximum refund of 29.98 Ecus per tonne, they said.
